title: Creepers Multiply
description: Creepers spawn a baby creeper on killing a player or entity/mobs
body:
🐾 Creeper Multiply Datapack
- Creepers now spawn a baby creeper upon killing a player - beware, they multiply!
- Install: Drop into your world's datapacks folder and run /reload.
- Compatible with: Minecraft Java Edition

For a new model on baby creepers download the [Baby Creepers RP](https://modrinth.com/project/SsawQpWU)!
